nodes.text:
Hotel and airline stocks nosedived up to 6.4% as India reported three Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases. COVID-era fears resurfaced, hitting hospitality and aviation shares hard—The Indian Hotels Company and InterGlobe Aviation saw significant declines.
